title: B6 Queue group across the cluster: 4 members on brokers B and C, publisher on broker A
note: 3 run(s) of 20000 messages. Each message must reach exactly ONE member in the whole cluster. The origin broker picks a peer at random, the peer picks a member at random, so 25% each is the expectation. Last column: a fifth member then joins on the publisher's own broker and 1000 more messages are sent; local preference means all of them should stay local.
columns: with a local member: local / remote
